outcome.summary: Implemented the approved portrait tutorial-prompt presentation as a pure consumer of EncounterEngine.get_tutorial_prompt_projection. The mobile HUD shows one short card at a time inside the physical safe lane, uses a visible non-blocking Dismiss control, exposes the authoritative full text through its tooltip, and keeps caller-owned dismissal/review state outside rules and Encounter Records. Help adds a text-first list of shown tips plus a selector and Review action that reopens the selected tip as its contextual card.
non_goal_compliance: No HUD-derived gameplay trigger, legal action, phase advancement, input authority, or protected next gesture was added.
No scripted mandatory tutorial, combat log, target-pattern UI, gameplay/content/deck/pacing/rules change, analytics backend, or Encounter Record prompt metadata was added.
The UI consumes the existing authoritative projection and stores dismissal/history only as local presentation state.
